newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank recommends state control in key banks.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank recommends state control in key banks.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) has told the government that the state should retain control in three of the four largest financial institutions, according an NBS paper obtained by Reuters on Wednesday.

The paper, presented earlier this week to the cabinet, recommends the state keep at least 51 percent in the largest savings bank Slovenska Sporitelna a.s., and at least 34-percent stakes in the largest commercial bank VUB a.s. and largest insurance company Slovenska Poistovna a.s..
The NBS said it had no objections to the complete selloff of Slovakia's second largest commercial bank IRB a.s.
